systems.country_label: the Nigeria Police Force's POSSAP platform
systems.tiers: named only as a platform citizens apply through that leans on NIN verification and has paired digitisation with fee increases; what it does is not described
ordered by the President as the default identity verification layer for every ministry, department and agency; POSSAP is said to lean on NIN as its verification backbone

note: On identity verification; the police appear only through POSSAP, named with no description of its function. Nothing on station records.
